title: The rendered AGENTS.md drops test-owned invariants and rule tails, within 2400 bytes
body:
Why: Fable audit 1114f (.krn/runs/overnight/fable-audit-1114f.md) fix 7: KRN-05/06/08 are owned by tests; the (owner; test; rationale) tails cost ~1.3 KB per session and subagent.
Outcome: scripts/render-agents.ts renders only rules agents must act on, without tails; spec/rules.json keeps the full records.
Proof: instruction-bytes test with AGENTS.md budget <= 2400.
